title: andrzejczakpack
body:
_andrzejczakpack_ is a thoughtfully optimized modpack with various features which allow to

- display data that could be manually checked using vanilla mechanics
- cut down on actions that could be done in comparable time
- document things that could be noted using external tools
- learn information that could be gathered from other sources
- render overlays facilitating spatial planning
- extend render distance using level of detail models
- host LAN words over the internet

while maintaining aesthetic minimalism and cleanliness, fixing many bugs and graphic inconsistencies, and offering visual enhancements consistent with the default textures of the game

## **List of features**

"/andrzejczakpack keybinds" and "/andrzejczakpack commands" generate a chat message with a cheat sheet\
Backup system prevents locally stored mods data from being lost after modpack update or save transfer\
Render distance extending system automatically toggles and sets radius of chunk generator for voxy

## **Installation**

<details>
<summary>Automatic</summary>

In the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app), [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org), or [ATLauncher](https://atlauncher.com), there should be added a new instance with the downloaded mrpack file imported. If the version is not detected, 1.21.11 with the most recent version of Fabric mod loader must be used

</details>

<details>
<summary>Manual</summary>

First, downloaded mrpack file needs to be converted to zip using an [external tool](https://jamie.codeberg.page/mrpack-to-zip). If it has never been done, [Fabric installer](https://fabricmc.net) must be downloaded and ran with the most recent loader version for 1.21.11 chosen. After that a new instance should have been created in the game launcher

Next - inside .minecraft in the %appdata% file directory in Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft in macOS, or ~/.minecraft in Linux - config, mods, resourcepacks, shaderpacks, and options.txt (provided they exist) have to be removed and then replaced with the contents of the zip file

</details>
